conditions: Six Sobol conditions, seed2804, wind1–5m/s, ignition azimuth0–360degrees, fixed original tree and moisture
runtime: Previously about6–8minutes solver elapsed per case; up to6workers, plus provisioning and download. Each workflow40minutes maximum including cleanup, solver25minutes maximum.
recovery: Checkpoints every30simulated seconds, retained in final bundles, same-Linux resume preflight before solve; no automatic retry or continuation
test_rule: No fresh FDS before model and all comparison forecasts frozen. Never revise test conditions in response to predicted or observed outcomes.
cost_caveat: Expected figure is compute estimate, not invoice total. Reservation includes ancillary and cleanup allowance. No reservations recycled.
